test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All carrots are onions.

No onion is a tomato.

Conclusions:

(i) No carrot is a tomato.

(ii) All onions are carrots.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f525a7d41a7a190f982de1f2921e1b37dd66377a3ff64cea7fd214f600c8be.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No carrot is a tomato → True (because all carrots are onions and no onion is a tomato so, also no onion is a tomato)

II. All onions are carrots → False (because It may be possible but not defined)

So, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
